verdict.rationale: Shopify's own documentation points developers to the official Shopify CLI to scaffold POS UI extensions, so an official CLI exists within the POS ecosystem. However, the only documented use is scaffolding extension configuration and files. Nothing shows the CLI operating POS itself (orders, carts, inventory) or supporting AI-native or agent workflows. missing for 10: CLI commands for operating POS data and actions, documentation of the CLI's POS-specific scope beyond scaffolding, AI or agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use Shopify CLI to scaffold your extension with the essential configuration and files.
Use [Shopify CLI](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-cli) to scaffold your extension with the essential configuration and files.
